DLG Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT DILG-NAPOLCOM Center, EDSA corner Quezon Avenue, West Triangle, Quezon City http: //www.dilg.com.ph DILG OPINION No. 54 s. 2022 June 30, 2022 HON. ROGELIO PANGILINAN Vice-Mayor and Presiding Officer Sangguniang Bayan Municipality of Naic, Cavite Dear Vice-Mayor Pangilinan: This has reference to the earlier letter of Mr. Edmar Villanueva Ginez, President, Hills View Royale Phase 3 Homeowners Association (HOA) Block 8, Lot 3, HillsView Royale Phase 3, Timalan Balsahan, Municipality of Naic, Province of Cavite requesting for the Department's guidance regarding the jurisdiction of the Sangguniang Bayan over disputes/issues within the HOA inviting him to attend a hearing regarding a petition to expel him as HOA President. Per the aforesaid letter of Mr. Gines, he received an invitation from Rodrigo A. Castillo, Chairman, Committee on Society Organization, Sangguniang Bayan, Municipality of Naic, Cavite, through HOA treasurer May M. Samson, to attend a hearing in relation to a petition to expel him as HOA President. Moreover, Mr. Gines clarified that the HOA is registered under the Department of Human Settlements and Urban Development as evidenced by a Certificate of Incorporation. Under this premise arose the request for guidance regarding the jurisdiction of the Sangguniang Bayan over disputes/issues within the HOA. At the outset, please be informed that disputes between and among members of homeowners' associations in villages are within the jurisdiction of the Housing and Land Use Regulatory Board (HLURB), now under the Human Settlements Adjudication Commission (HSAC) by virtue of Republic Act No. 11201 otherwise known as the "Human Settlements and Urban Development Act". The HSAC is a purely quasi-judicial agency mandated to adjudicate disputes relating to homeowners association, •or intra- association disputes of associations registered under Department of Human Settlements and Urban Development (DHSUD). Consistently, Rule 11 of the Implementing Rules and Regulations (IRR) of the Magna Carta for Homeowners and Homeowners' Associationsl provides that the HLURB is empowered to hear and decide intra-association and/or intra-association controversies 1 Board Resolution No. 877 Series of 2011. "Matino, Mahusay at Maaasahan" Trunkline No.: 8876-34-54

connected with the regulation of associations or dealing with the internal affairs of such entity. " Correspondingly, considering that the issue herein is about the removal of an officer of a homeowners association, which pertains to an internal affair of the association, the matter is an intra-association dispute or controversy. In addition, taking into account the fact that the association is registered under the DSHUD, it falls squarely under the jurisdiction of the HSAC. In view of the foregoing, it is the HSAC which has jurisdiction over the matter and not the Sangguniang Bayan. Please be guided accordingly. Very respectfully yours, By the Authority of the Secretary: MARL GAN, CESO Ill Undersec ry for Local Government OSEC/EMA/LLLS-LRALLD/rjki/clp Copy furnished: DIRECTOR ARIEL O.
